issue.title: Orchagent crash in warm-reboot upgrade between master kvm images

failure.body:
**Description**
Orchagent crash in warm-reboot upgrade between master kvm images

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Install new sonic kvm image from master branch using sonic-installer
2. Warm reboot
3.

**Describe the results you received:**
```
Dec 10 <IPV6>.048499 vlab-01 ERR swss#orchagent: :- removeDefaultBridgePorts: Failed to get bridge port list in default 1Q bridge, rv:-8
Dec 10 <IPV6>.049958 vlab-01 INFO swss#/supervisord: orchagent terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
Dec 10 <IPV6>.052166 vlab-01 INFO swss#/supervisord: orchagent   what():  PortsOrch initialization failure
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
Expect the image to boot up without any problem

resolution.title: [warm-reboot] Remove warmboot file path that overrides the default path
resolution.description:
**- Why I did it**
The sai.profile file in kvm images overrides the warmboot file with path `/var/cache/sai_warmboot.bin`. Since the directory `/var/cache` is not mounted in syncd, it will be cleared in an image upgrade, the warm-reboot image upgrade will fail if the file is put in the directory.

Fix https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/6183

**- How I did it**
Remove the path that overrides the default path. The warmboot file path will then be the default value `/var/warmboot/sai-warmboot.bin`. Since `/var/warmboot/` is mounted by `/host/warmboot/` in the host, it could survive an image upgrade.

**- How to verify it**
Tested warm reboot upgrading kvm image locally.
